fields.summary_ko.0: BofA raised Eli Lilly (LLY:NYSE) price target to $1,600, suggesting 19% upside from current levels, while maintaining Buy rating.
fields.summary_ko.1: LLY's Q3 revenue grew 39%, significantly outpacing Novo Nordisk (4%), and 2026 guidance was raised to $91-92B.
fields.summary_ko.2: Beyond obesity treatments, peak sales of $5-15B are expected from new neurological drugs (cleminorexton, AtaiBeckley), securing additional growth drivers.
